name: Gmail MCP
description: Gmail integration for drafting cover letters, follow-up emails, and thank-you notes. Search threads to track recruiter conversations and label messages by application stage.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a Gmail draft (cover letters, follow-ups, thank-you notes)

tools.name: search_threads
tools.description: Search Gmail threads to find recruiter conversations

tools.name: label_thread
tools.description: Label a thread by application stage

notes: Authenticated via Google OAuth. User email: goesef@gmail.com. Drafts are never auto-sent — human reviews and sends.
